review.title: Optimized rumen SynCom: four reference correspondences with five-stock and animal-study limits
review.independence_basis: The whole current record, selected retained primary Methods/Results/Conclusion passages, original batch79 decision and complete historical caller were read before source preparation. Independent source, local preview and actual M5 candidate/input reviews preceded guarded application. The check/history configuration was independently reviewed before eight serial native commands. This is a partial technical diagnostic, not a new full scientific review.
review.summary: Four descriptors in the five-stock optimized rumen SynCom now carry native GTDB species-reference blocks and GROUNDED statuses. Three use exact NCBI species IDs and Lactobacillus delbrueckii 5812 uses a species-name fallback. Streptococcus equinus 5640 retains its complete three-option ambiguity. All five stock identities, source names and quotations, experimental boundaries, three graph nodes, zero downstream arrows and previous history remain unchanged. Actual M5 application, two native inline events, one sidecar and eight scoped native commands are bound. Reference populations do not identify study assemblies, establish durable engraftment or support new causal roles.
review.scope_description: Four taxonomy blocks and grounding statuses at indices 1-4; preserved index0 ambiguity; source-stock, species-route and reference-population boundaries; actual guarded application, append-only native history and eight scoped technical checks. Existing biological claims and scientific limitations are preserved without a new approval judgment.
review.selection: CommunityMech:000398 follows the completed, independently verified Sorghum 348 canary on the same frozen c9bb M5 path. Transwell 091 and LaCa 395 completed their separate saved-input checkpoints before this application. This diagnostic covers only the optimized rumen SynCom, record 398.
limitations: Partial technical diagnostic with scientific_review:false. Native validator success does not establish full scientific approval, fresh source-snippet certification, generated-product verification, aggregate QC completion or closure of earlier findings.

Primary coverage consists of selected retained Methods single-strain/constructed-community experiments, whole-genome sequencing, strain annotation and in-situ design; Group41 Results, genomic annotation, in-situ outcomes, Conclusion and data availability. Separate supplementary tables, original figure pixels, raw sequence data and deposited study assemblies were not independently audited. This is not a fresh complete paper or stock-collection review.

The five optimized stocks remain distinct from the initial seven-member designs. Source whole-genome sequencing statements and BioProject PRJNA1297957 do not establish an independently checked assembly-to-stock or crosswalk-genome match. All stock strings and original NCBI names remain unchanged.

Native species reference totals and majority fractions are L. delbrueckii 5812 total376/fraction1.0, P. acetatigenes 6076 total1/fraction1.0, E. lactis 6088 total574/fraction0.99 and P. mucosa 6360 total7/fraction1.0. These are totals and fractions, not explicit support numerators, experimental abundances, animal replication, bag counts or probabilities of source-stock placement. No numerator is reconstructed from a rounded fraction.

L. delbrueckii uses a species-name fallback at the existing species anchor, without importing a subspecies grounding from another record. The other three routes use exact NCBI species IDs. Enterococcus_B lactis is a reference label, not a rename of stock 6088. Index0 S. equinus 5640 and all three equinus/pasteurianus/ruminicola alternatives remain unchanged; no source-genome adjudication was performed.

Significant Group41 laboratory NDFD remains distinct from null dry-matter/gas endpoints, added-suspension concentrations from final-bottle concentrations, and genomic annotation from measured expression, flux or exchange. Cattle outcomes retain time-specific effects, nonsignificant 72-hour fiber trends and three animals per group; nested bags do not become independent animals. Durable engraftment and taxon-specific animal effects remain unproved. No node, arrow, phenotype or mechanistic claim is added.

Captured issue1655 is CLOSED after an earlier graph correction; captured issue1658 is OPEN and retains the non-graph provenance-vocabulary discrepancy. These snapshots are bounded historical evidence, not fresh issue-state checks at diagnostic save time. Current native schema/strict success does not erase that semantic limitation or establish a demonstrated validator failure.

Crosswalk SHA256 761d5537 identifies exact bytes without an established release or chronology. Native mapping_source reflects file mtime, not release provenance. Local NCBI label/rank observations retain database identity/stat rather than a full database digest or certified release.

Source preparation used its recorded earlier revision; actual M5 staging, application and all eight native commands used c9bb51a8b2a5591400dc8f170f043e59642116ce with Python 3.13.2 on named isolated branch review/gtdb-final-four-m5-20261116. The execution tree contains applied records and is not a clean-HEAD aggregate QC run. Local mirroring is a verified copy of actual M5 bytes, not a separate local application.

Four statuses changed among five processed descriptors. Two native inline events and one native sidecar preserve previous history. Older unresolved-grounding notes remain historical observations, not a claim that the newly mapped descriptors still lack current correspondences. Later strict batch79 admission must authenticate the bounded current transition before projecting only its old hash/latest-event expectations, retaining current biology, other records and the separate Okeke historical handling.

The native term command explicitly passed but did not emit an assertion denominator; none is invented. Complete saved-input checkpoints, public proof export, strict historical admission, current measured source comparisons, generated products and final combined QC remain separate required steps.

assessments.topic: Five distinct optimized stocks with unchanged experimental boundaries
assessments.summary: The retained primary passages support the preserved five-stock optimized roster and distinguish it from earlier designs. Study sequencing statements are not independently audited assembly matches. Laboratory effects, genomic predictions, animal replication, nested subsamples and unresolved persistence remain distinct; all prior scientific limits are retained.

assessments.topic: Three exact-ID and one species-name correspondence with retained ambiguity
assessments.summary: Four selected species results retain exact reference totals and fractions, including E. lactis 6088 total574/fraction0.99. L. delbrueckii 5812 uses an explicit species-name fallback; the other three use exact species IDs. No numerator, stock rename, assembly identity, experimental abundance or functional transfer is inferred. S. equinus and all three alternatives remain untouched.
